title: Keep one job in a function
summary: A small function with one clear job is easier to test and reuse. Separate a calculation from drawing a page.
introduction: A small function with one clear job is easier to test and reuse. Separate a calculation from drawing a page. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain keep one job in a function
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A small function with one clear job is easier to test and reuse. Separate a calculation from drawing a page.

blocks.code:
const totalPrice = prices => prices.reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0);
console.log(totalPrice([2, 3]));
blocks.title: Keep one job in a function

blocks.text: The result is 5. This function calculates a total and does not change the page.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a separate function that formats the total as text.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not mix a simple calculation with unrelated saving and navigation.
For more detail later, use this [Clean Code further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Writing_guidelines/Code_style_guide/JavaScript).
